identities.name: schemaHash
identities.projection: H(schema, sorted relative schema/descriptor paths + raw SHA256).

identities.name: evidenceHash
identities.projection: H(evidence, EvidenceRecord projection excluding retrieval timestamps only).

identities.name: modelHash
identities.projection: H(model, materialized model-input.json; authored mechanical records only, no generated geometry/solutions/meshes or maturity).

identities.name: graphHash
identities.projection: H(graph, variant graph-input: ordered operations/steps, connections, copied referenced rule/measurement/procedure/warning/motion values, semantic initialState excluding graphHash/modelHash/stateHash/stockDispositionHash).

identities.name: toolchainHash
identities.projection: Exact locks, OS/container, architecture, normalized build options; no wall-clock paths/times.

identities.name: cadHash
identities.projection: Sorted generated CAD raw hashes and independent feature-table hashes.

identities.name: solverHash
identities.projection: Solver implementation/config/input constraint policy, excludes solution artifact.

identities.name: solutionsHash
identities.projection: Sorted solution IDs + final document raw hashes. No solutionsHash in solution.

identities.name: meshHash
identities.projection: Final GLB/texture/decoder paths, raw hash/length, ownership/LOD; no reports/root manifest.

identities.name: packHash
identities.projection: H(pack, RuntimeManifest omitting only top-level packHash).

identities.name: stockDispositionHash
identities.projection: H(stock, complete instance ID/location/parent/owned-state, lots and allocations sorted by ID).

identities.name: stateHash
identities.projection: H(state, complete AssemblyState omitting only top-level stateHash after stock recomputation).

laterArtifactPolicy: No later milestone artifact generated merely to fill a hash slot.
